scope: Offline conditional risk checks only. Per-trade maximum loss is 5% of verified total account value, capped at $25. Open-plus-pending exposure is measured as maximum loss (premium + fee bound + stress reserve) and capped at the same amount (one position). Daily limit: $30 of realized gross losses plus committed open/pending maximum loss per America/Los_Angeles day; wins do not replenish it. Account owner limits recorded 2026-09-27.
